t: Why the night was taken back
a: إِنِّي خَرَجْتُ لأُخْبِرَكُمْ بِلَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ، وَإِنَّهُ تَلاَحَى فُلاَنٌ وَفُلاَنٌ فَرُفِعَتْ وَعَسَى أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرًا لَكُمُ
p: Innī kharajtu li-ukhbirakum bi-laylati-l-qadr, wa innahu talāḥā fulānun wa fulānun fa-rufiʿat, wa ʿasā an yakūna khayran lakum
m: I came out to tell you about the Night of Decree, and so and so and so and so quarrelled, and it was taken up. And perhaps that is better for you.
